name: normalize — requirements review (no tool use)
task_prompt: Derive a function contract for normalize(input string) string satisfying these acceptance criteria: (1) output is lowercase, (2) spaces replaced with underscores, (3) leading/trailing whitespace removed.
notes: Non-software frame. Tests ground token on a non-executable subject: agent must derive formal properties from the acceptance criteria, check atomicity, and produce a coverage check confirming each criterion maps to a property.
eval_notes: Score: (1) 'Ground properties:' block appears before any design sketch or prose contract, containing one property [N]: per acceptance criterion; (2) each property [N]: line uses formal notation (∀/∃ predicate, typed expression, or relational formula) — prose-only lines do not satisfy; (3) atomicity check is performed — at least one split attempt documented with outcome (valid split → divided, no valid split → atomic); (4) properties are independent — satisfying one does not determine another (agent must state this or demonstrate it); (5) 'Coverage: complete' or equivalent coverage check appears mapping each acceptance criterion to a property [N]; (6) if any criterion admits multiple interpretations, an 'Interpretation:' line appears before the first property [N]: line. All six required for PASS.
